variants.title: FMR of a permalloy film: Kittel fit for Ms and damping
variants.sample: Ni80Fe20 permalloy film, 50 nm, field in plane (SIMULATED)
variants.unknown: Kittel relation fit, saturation magnetisation, damping
variants.note: In-plane film: f = (g muB/h) sqrt(B(B + mu0 Ms)), so resonance comes at low field; f^2/B against B gives mu0 Ms, and the width against f gives alpha about 0.008. Values quoted from memory - verify.

source.title: C. Kittel, Phys. Rev. 73, 155 (1948); permalloy values from memory - verify
